description: This source file implements HTTP handlers for managing agent packages within a control plane. It provides endpoints to list packages and retrieve detailed package information, including configuration and runtime status. The code integrates with storage services and uses gin-gonic for HTTP routing.

classes.name: PackageHandler
classes.description: Handles HTTP requests related to agent package management, including listing packages and obtaining package details.

classes.name: PackageInfo
classes.description: Represents summarized information of a package for listing purposes.

classes.name: PackageDetailsResponse
classes.description: Represents detailed information about a package, including configuration and capability details.

classes.name: PackageConfiguration
classes.description: Holds configuration schema and current settings for a package.

classes.name: PackageCapabilities
classes.description: Contains the capabilities of a package such as reasoners, skills, and MCP servers.

classes.name: ReasonerDefinition
classes.description: Defines a reasoner component within a package's capabilities.

classes.name: SkillDefinition
classes.description: Defines a skill component within a package's capabilities.

classes.name: MCPServerDefinition
classes.description: Defines an MCP server component within a package's capabilities.

classes.name: PackageRuntime
classes.description: Contains runtime details of a package, like process ID, port, node ID, and logs.

methods.name: ListPackagesHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler for listing all agent packages with optional filtering by status and search.

methods.name: GetPackageDetailsHandler
methods.description: HTTP handler for retrieving detailed info about a specific package by ID.

methods.name: determinePackageStatus
methods.description: Determines the current operational status of a package based on configuration and lifecycle state.

methods.name: matchesSearch
methods.description: Checks if a package matches the provided search term.

methods.name: safeStringValue
methods.description: Converts a *string to string safely, handling nil pointers.
